text: Fresh tomatoes, fresh basil, 15 minutes. Dinner does not get simpler than this. The secret is to cook the sauce only briefly so the tomatoes stay bright and sweet. I add a spoon of pasta water, a drop of olive oil, and a pinch of salt, and that is it. Good ingredients need very little help. Here is the full recipe for two people. Boil 200 grams of spaghetti in well-salted water. While it cooks, warm two tablespoons of olive oil with one sliced garlic clove, add 300 grams of halved cherry tomatoes, and let them soften for about five minutes. Add the drained pasta with a splash of cooking water and toss everything together for one minute. Finish with fresh basil and a little grated parmesan.
